reading.title: Does Europe regret its bet on U.S. defense?
reading.summary: Europe bet big on American defense technology and they're now paying the price. Years-long backlogs are underway due to production delays and the U.S. own military needs.

news.title: Xi said China would welcome American students for exchanges. What's the reality?
news.summary: President Trump and China's leader Xi Jinping are due to meet in the Chinese city of Shenzhen. At their last summit in September, Xi said he will welcome 100,000 American students for exchanges.
